scenarios.title: Explore (optional)
scenarios.question: If there is time: explore freely. Two things the table can do that a map cannot. Copy: press Copy on the table toolbar (or A on the right controller) and click an area; a 3D copy pops up. Hold the grip with the ray on it to carry it and put it next to another area. Compare: press Compare and click two areas; the Compare panel shows A and B side by side with their differences.
